stories.title: Moses Matovu murder: Suspect remanded to Luzira
stories.excerpt: A 47-year-old driver, Vincent Arnold Nsamba, stands in the dock at the Makindye Chief Magistrate’s Court during his arraignment on murder charges following…
stories.summary: A 47-year-old driver, Vincent Arnold Nsamba, stands in the dock at the Makindye Chief Magistrate’s Court during his arraignment on murder charges following the death of Ugandan music icon and long-serving Afrigo Band leader Moses Matovu. Nsamba, accused of the murder of legendary Afrigo Band leader Moses Matovu, was formally charged and remanded to Luzira Upper Prison until November 3, 2026. Her co-accused, 47-year-old Vincent Arnold Nsamba, was formally charged with Matovu's murder and remanded to Luzira Upper Prison until November 3, 2026.
